title: SkyDoom
tagline: DOOM's weapons, HUD and arsenal in Skyrim: fight dragons with a shotgun and a BFG.
description: Your Dragonborn carries DOOM's arsenal: fists, pistol, shotgun, chaingun, rocket launcher, plasma rifle and the BFG, all from the start. DOOM's weapons hit Skyrim's people and creatures, rockets knock them flying, and Skyrim's enemies drop DOOM health, armour and ammo. DOOM's own HUD, weapon sprites and sounds run inside Skyrim through a real DOOM engine (Chocolate Doom) that reads your own copy of DOOM. Keys 1 to 7 pick weapons, F10 turns DOOM's music on and off.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition

knownIssues: Early beta: tiny see-through specks can show in the DOOM weapons now and then.
Blood and gore come from Skyrim's own hit effects, so they're tamer than in DOOM.
Knockback can be uneven on very large or unusual Skyrim creatures.
Play with keyboard and mouse: controllers aren't the focus of this beta.
Only DOOM + DOOM II from Steam (the 2024 version) is supported.

important.text: Install DOOM + DOOM II from Steam. SkyDoom uses your own copy of DOOM; it isn't included.
